name: Slabhold scanner hard-cards test set
scoring: right/open/wrong per field; open beats wrong; any wrong is a blocker
notes: typical_ocr_front lines are modeled on how the printed front reads (name, team/school, stamps, serial); they are not captured from photos. Serials shown with digits come from real sold listings; "/175"-style lines mean the serial prefix was not recorded.
checklist = checklistinsider.com / diamondcardsonline.com; listing = SportsCardsPro product page, which shows real eBay sold titles (eBay itself blocked direct fetches).
listing_title_examples are real seller titles, kept because they show how the market words each card (including seller mistakes).
